# TagField

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:tag-field` · Kerf UI · component · Controls

A form field that collects short values as removable tags: SearchField's token editor in its form-field presentation, with a label, hint or error, a leading tag glyph, chips that edit or remove, a clear button, an optional max, and a hidden input per tag submitted under its name.

## When to use

Collect a list of short values (labels, recipients, keywords) as removable tags, each submitted as its own form value.

- A form collects several short values of one kind (labels, recipients, keywords): render TagField with tags and name, wire wireTagFields with onChange, and re-render with the list it reports.
- Values must be checked (an email shape, a known label) or capped: pass normalize and max, and show onReject's reason as the field's error.

**Not when:**

- Do not use it for search filters; SearchField combines free text with ordered, editable filter tokens.
- Do not use it to pick from a short fixed set; use ChoiceChips or a multiple Select.
- Do not use wa-tag-input.

**Alternatives:**

- [SearchField](./search-field.md) (nearest) — Use SearchField when the tokens are search filters rather than submitted form values.
- [ChoiceChips](./choice-chips.md) (nearest) — Use ChoiceChips to pick several from a short known set.

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/tag-field` — exports `TagField`, `TagFieldProps`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/tag-field` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/tag-field.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Wiring: `wireTagFields` from `@kerfjs/ui/wire-tag-fields` (required).
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/tag-field`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuitag-field) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.
- Built from: [SearchField](./search-field.md), [LucideIcon](./lucide-icon.md).

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** the tag list (update it from onChange and re-render); validation and normalization (normalize) and showing refusals (onReject, error); the field name and form association.

**Wiring:** `wireTagFields` is required.

- Use wireTagFields as documented.

## Geometry

Margin: child · border: child · padding: child (layout role: controls). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

- The SearchField form-field presentation draws the label, frame, chips, and hint; TagField adds no geometry of its own.

## Accessibility

- The editor is named by the visible label and described by the hint or error; each chip has an edit button (its label) and a remove button named for the tag.
- Enter or a delimiter adds the typed text, Backspace at the start removes the last tag, ArrowLeft and ArrowRight move between chips and the editor, and Backspace or Delete on a focused chip removes it.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-tag-field`.

Never put `kui-tag-field` on an element you write; render `TagField` instead (`KUI-L103`).

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
